I added `--org` to `clever addon providers`, but I couldn't run any checks, so it is untested.

`npm run docs` failed with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`, and `npm run validate` failed because `eslint` isn't installed. Dependencies don't seem to be installed here. Nothing has been linted or typechecked, and the docs weren't regenerated, so `addon.docs.md` and the generated docs still need `npm run docs` after `npm install`.

The only change is in `src/commands/addon/addon.providers.command.js`. It reuses the shared `orgaIdOrNameOption`, as `addon list` and `addon create` do. The handler resolves the owner with `getOwnerIdFromOrgIdOrName`, so without `--org` it uses your user. It passes that ID to `Addon.listProviders()`, which already accepted an org ID.

I haven't run the command against the API. Without `--org`, the call now passes your user ID where it previously passed none, so the request changes slightly. I haven't checked whether the provider list is the same.
